approval_required_for: No approval is required for the bounded immutable-contract harness materialization and evidence reruns above. Obtain explicit approval before any ambiguous board target/wrapper selection, wrapper substitution, architecture or pipeline change, memory-layout change, numeric-policy/tolerance change, or major template change.

consumes: current case-adapter target checkpoint and immutable stimulus provenance
current immutable numeric-policy and tolerance artifact
current target-layer selection and Transformer-block parameter metadata
existing certified lower-layer reference evidence, reusable only as provenance and not as board functional pass evidence
executable_actions.on_failure: Keep case_multilayer_pipeline and functional_sim blocked. If the complete tensor catalog, independent target-model inference reference, immutable tolerance, canonical board_tb.sv mapping, or exact wrapper identity cannot be established, classify it as a current verification/harness capability defect. Do not alter expected outputs, weights, numeric policy, r5 probe source, wrapper sources, or lower-layer RTL. If target/wrapper selection is ambiguous, stop and request bounded approval rather than guessing.
produces: verification/board_simulation/board_tb.sv with source-identity and SHA-256 binding to the authorized canonical source
executable_actions.rationale: Repair the current verification-capability gap without editing the existing r5 probe or changing the semantic contract. Build complete Transformer-block-only board-scope binding evidence, a target-model reference for the same immutable checkpoint/stimulus, and a canonical board_tb.sv path only when the exact sample-project source-identity contract authorizes its byte/hash mapping.

consumes: current exact wrapper/source hashes and VCS compile-authority records
executable_actions.on_failure: If multilayer binding or harness checks fail, return only to repair.prepare_exact_board_multilayer_harness_and_weight_binding with the failed catalog, loader, harness, or identity field identified. If AXI/DDR compile authority or identity fails, repair the exact current board integration metadata/harness slice or seek approval for unresolved target ambiguity. Do not invoke VCS, diagnose RTL, reopen a lower layer, or promote.
executable_actions.rationale: Test the repaired content-addressed board harness before hardware simulation. This rerun decides whether the entry blockers are actually removed and whether exact Vivado-export/source-identity compile authority is sufficient for the AXI/DDR board layer.

consumes: passing current-candidate case_multilayer_pipeline and case_axi_ddr_interface reports
immutable numeric-policy artifact and exact sample-project wrapper/source hashes
executable_actions.on_failure: If compilation, event emission, or same-record r5 field validation fails, return to the board harness/instrumentation capability repair and retain all board gates as blocked; do not apply a duplicate probe patch. If the replay shows liveness, value, ordering, or protocol failure, preserve the trace and run repair.localize_post_r5_causal_slice before any code repair. Do not infer a lower-layer defect from output absence alone.
produces: fresh source-bound progress_event_log.jsonl containing the complete r5 event record required by the existing event_match schema
executable_actions.rationale: After entry gates pass, obtain the first admissible hardware observation for this loop: a fresh real VCS compile/elaboration and replay bound to the existing r5-instrumented testbench SHA. The replay must correlate adapter/core start, ingress, stage-0, and egress/frontier facts in the single r5 event required by the existing event_match schema.

consumes: current SACG contamination barriers and open retry requests
executable_actions.on_failure: If the trace does not identify an earliest boundary or is inconsistent with its source hashes, request another bounded replay rather than patching RTL. Permit only a board wrapper, loader, harness, AXI/DDR integration, or runtime-boundary repair when the trace localizes one. Emit a lower-layer backtrack request only when the current trace directly contradicts a named lower-layer certificate invariant with current core-start, ingress, egress, causal-boundary, and certificate evidence; otherwise explicitly retain lower certificates.
executable_actions.rationale: Convert the fresh board replay into one bounded repair decision at the earliest causal boundary. This action separates verifier/instrumentation gaps from wrapper/loader/integration defects and prevents the downstream frontier symptom from selecting an output module or certified kernel as a root cause.

consumes: passing current-candidate VCS functional record and r5 validation
exact wrapper and testbench source hashes
executable_actions.on_failure: Do not assemble a passing semantic-evidence claim or promote. Feed a real liveness, value, order, protocol, DDR, or numeric failure back to repair.localize_post_r5_causal_slice using its earliest trace boundary. Treat missing reference, binding, source identity, or comparison capability as a verification/harness repair and preserve immutable comparison inputs.
executable_actions.rationale: Run the remaining board-layer functional closure only if the same hash-bound candidate has passed entry gates and the fresh replay is functionally admissible. This verifies AXI/deadlock behavior, data movement, numeric comparison against independent target-model expected outputs, and the required semantic evidence without changing the comparison policy.

consumes: all current-candidate board entry, VCS, trace, functional, deadlock, AXI, DDR, numeric, and semantic-evidence reports
executable_actions.on_failure: Retain the active barriers and retries as downstream-consumption blockers, keep backend synthesis/implementation/bitstream/runtime/board promotion disabled, and return to the earliest failed current-layer action. Do not clear or supersede rejected-lineage records based on a partial gate run, smoke result, or reused historical diagnosis.
produces: artifact.stage7.verification_result candidate with content-addressed source and tool bindings
executable_actions.rationale: Address all active board-scope contamination barriers and open retries through a fresh content-addressed Stage7 candidate, rather than consuming rejected artifacts or declaring the repair plan promoted. Reconciliation is allowed only after every required current-layer gate has real-tool pass evidence bound to one immutable candidate.

observations: The conditional design-team router selected no specialist split; its no_split result is consistent with the unambiguous verification-capability failure and does not replace the failed real-tool result.
real_tool.case_multilayer_pipeline executed and failed with multilayer_real_weight_binding and multilayer_harness_sources absent. This is the earliest executable board-scope blocker.

functional_sim failed only because board_tb.sv and prerequisite gates are absent. The VCS functional simulator, evidence analyzer, AXI diagnostics, deadlock diagnostics, multilayer functional gate, and board semantic assembler are not_run; none supplies current board RTL failure evidence.

The prior repair execution establishes that the existing source-bound testbench already contains r5 probe.connected_kernel_internal_pipeline.5 at SHA-256 8f4e67451f32c90ee94291a3a33b10dbffdd211fffff68300665fd6a458c307d. A duplicate/no-op probe patch is prohibited; the missing r5 evidence is a fresh execution record and matching JSONL event from that exact source state.

The old VCS diagnosis reporting no accepted kernel output is explicitly historical_only for this current layer because it lacks an applicability binding. It may not be used to select an RTL root cause; it only reinforces the need for the fresh r5 replay after static prerequisites pass.

The operator-leaf and single-transformer-layer certificates are live hash-validated lower-layer evidence. The connected kernel remains an elastic variable-latency token pipeline with verified boundary ordering and cross-token overlap; unequal stage durations are not a failure. No current trace contradicts either certificate, and no scoped backtrack request is open.

sacg_memory_truth reports 10 active current-scope contamination barriers across rejected board candidates and 4 open retry requests, with zero scoped open backtracks. These records block downstream consumption and promotion; they do not authorize a lower-layer reopen.

The active rejected discovery lineage and the current candidate must be kept distinct. Current board source identity must be revalidated against the exact user-supplied wrapper and the canonical testbench path before VCS invocation; path ambiguity must not be resolved by guessing.
proposed_actions: Materialize only the missing board multilayer loader/harness closure and canonical testbench-path binding from the exact existing identity contract; preserve all immutable semantic inputs and the existing r5 probe source.
Rerun case_board_interface_discovery, case_multilayer_pipeline, and case_axi_ddr_interface on that one content-addressed candidate before invoking VCS.

When those entry gates pass, run the required exact-source VCS targeted replay and analyzer to obtain one fresh r5 event containing the adapter-defined complete event field set and a post-r5 causal frontier.

Use the new trace to localize the earliest violated current-layer boundary. Repair only the resulting loader, harness, wrapper, interconnect, or runtime slice; schedule lower-layer revalidation only if the trace meets the explicit contradiction standard.

Only after a successful VCS functional result should the remaining current-layer functional, deadlock, AXI protocol, DDR roundtrip, semantic-evidence, and numeric-comparison gates run, followed by a content-addressed Stage7 retry and SACG trust-barrier reconciliation.
risks: A tensor manifest without complete Transformer-block scope, per-tensor hashes, loader binding, and executed DUT-consumption proof would falsely treat on-disk weights as consumed.

Generating expected outputs from random data, RTL output, or an identity/default model would invalidate functional correctness. The independent target-model inference output must use the same immutable checkpoint and stimulus as the DUT run.

Materializing verification/board_simulation/board_tb.sv from a non-identical or unapproved wrapper would violate exact board-wrapper identity and could hide AXI, DDR, reset, address-map, data-order, or runtime-ABI defects.

Independent DDR prefetch or AXI progress cannot establish output/lifecycle progress. The r5 frontier event is localization evidence only and cannot itself prove liveness or identify an RTL root cause.

A current trace showing a board output-frontier stall alone is insufficient to reopen the connected kernel. Revalidation would require a direct, hash-bound contradiction of a named lower-layer invariant with core-start, ingress, egress, and causal-boundary evidence.

Changing tolerances, checkpoint, stimulus, reference, semantic testbench contract, or wrapper hashes during this loop would contaminate comparison results. Missing verifier capability remains a harness/checker repair, not hardware correctness.
The active SACG barriers and retries prevent backend synthesis, implementation, bitstream, runtime ABI release, and board-runtime promotion until a fresh passing board candidate is reconciled.

constraints: The immutable checkpoint, stimulus, target-model inference reference, numeric comparison policy and tolerances, semantic testbench contract, and exact board-wrapper hashes must not change during repair.

Coverage and consumption proof must include every required Transformer-block tensor for every target layer; embedding/tokenization, final norm, LM head/logits, sampling, and other model-tail work are outside DUT scope.

The canonical board testbench may only be materialized or bound from the existing source-identity contract; no simplified wrapper, guessed target, duplicate r5 probe, or unrecorded source substitution is allowed.

Certified operator-leaf and elastic connected-single-layer evidence may be reused. A lower-layer revalidation requires a current hash-bound board trace directly contradicting a named certificate invariant with core start, ingress, egress, and named causal-boundary evidence.
Active contamination barriers and open retry requests are downstream-consumption blockers until a complete content-addressed passing board-scope candidate is rechecked and reconciled.
edges: complete Transformer-block tensor catalog -> loader manifest -> DUT weight-consumption binding
exact sample-project wrapper and source-identity contract -> hash-verified board testbench -> VCS compile/elaboration
accepted input handshake -> kernel lifecycle start -> ingress/stage-0/egress r5 correlation -> output/lifecycle frontier

Restore the immutable-contract board harness and binding closure, rerun the board entry gates, then obtain the required fresh hash-bound r5 VCS boundary replay before any wrapper, adapter, or kernel repair. Do not reopen certified lower layers or promote to backend/board runtime.
